_doc: Game-day text and the sideline warmup. Play-by-play lines pick one template at random; {us}/{them} are team names, {player} a fictional teammate, {yards}/{spot} numbers. The warmup is offered once per half, the first time your offense drives into range. Its result names a game-day modifier (modifiers.json) that lasts until halftime / the end of the game, plus stat changes applied when the game ends (through the stat rules).

warmup.offer: {us} are driving: ball on the {spot}. Coach says: "Kicker, get loose."
warmup.offer_hint: Warm up on the sideline net? It takes a few kicks.

pure.text: Pure contact. The leg feels great.

skipped.text: You stay on the bench. Your leg is cold.

outlook._doc: Game Day Outlook 'Your leg today' words: a profile value below cuts[0] gets words[0], and so on; above the last cut gets the last word.
outlook.tip: Warm up on the sideline net when the offense first drives into range (once per half): it helps your kicks until halftime. Skipping it leaves your leg cold.

calls.fg: Coach: "Field goal unit! {yards} yards. Let's go!"
calls.kickoff: Coach: "Kickoff team, you're up. Kick it deep."
calls.onside: Coach: "ONSIDE! We need the ball back. Soft and to the side."

td_us: TOUCHDOWN! {player} takes it in from {yards} yards out!
coach_no_trust: Coach waves off the kick from {yards}. {us} punt instead.
